prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Portal website visual-direction comp for a full responsive redesign
Input image: the existing Portal logo is a brand reference and must remain recognizable; do not redesign it.
Primary request: Create a shippable high-fidelity desktop landing-page comp for the conventional category-standard direction, used only as an honest comparison on a design decision board.
Surface structure: landscape desktop first viewport with a compact navigation bar; centered headline and direct platform download actions; an uncropped full-width 2.39:1 stage for the real Portal showcase film; show the opening edge of a restrained feature section below. It must clearly read as a website, not a poster or standalone illustration.
Product truth: Portal is a floating desktop widget that opens official AI websites such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini without accumulating browser tabs. Portal is available for Windows and macOS.
Style/medium: realistic polished product UI mockup, familiar modern desktop-software SaaS composition.
Color palette: command black #07030d, white, purple #a855f7, soft lilac #d8b4fe.
Materials: soft gradient glow, restrained glass panels, clean product-media frame.
Text (verbatim): "Portal"; "Your AI chats, one click away."; "Download for Windows"; "Download for macOS"; "ChatGPT"; "Claude"; "Gemini".
Typography: crisp contemporary sans serif, readable and production-minded.
Constraints: keep the real Portal logo recognizable; make both download actions unmistakable; preserve the entire ultrawide film aspect; no fabricated chat messages, testimonials, metrics, customer logos, press claims, pricing, or detailed fake app screenshots; no laptop mockup; no bento grid; no watermark.
Honest risk to express: polished and clear but intentionally familiar and not especially differentiated.
